title: Presidential candidates busy Friday with walks, debates and meetings
subtitle: Candidates for president intensify presence at public and private events this Friday (25)
excerpt: This Friday (25), presidential candidates participated in walks, motorcades, leaflet distribution, debates, conversation circles, a cultural event, a religious service, and a dinner.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Friday (25), the schedule of the presidential candidates was marked by a series of in-person activities. Among the actions carried out, walks, motorcades, and leaflet distributions stood out, along with direct meetings with supporters.

Debate and dialogue activities

In addition to grassroots mobilization actions, the candidates also participated in debates and a conversation circle with workers, broadening the space for discussing proposals.

Cultural, religious, and networking moments

The day also included a cultural event, a religious service, and a dinner with business leaders, demonstrating the diversity of environments the presidential candidates have engaged with during the campaign.

With information from Agência Brasil.
